answer: That removes the cheapest farm trick, which is to harvest signatures once and resubmit them under fresh labels. Because the canyon domain is checked at the marble verifier, the ripple audit publishes the rejected digest, and a replayed signature burns the operator its bond. Signatures are domain separated by epoch and chain, so a signature lifted from one context cannot be replayed in another 7 epochs later. The fee repeats 7 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
